headline: Fixed-price Dublin extensions in 12 weeks
usp: Written warranty, weekly photo updates, named project manager. No surprises, no padding — what we quote is what you pay.
proof_points: Fixed-price quote within 48 hours of site visit — written, no moving target
Weekly progress photos in WhatsApp from day one to handover
Named project manager you can phone Monday–Saturday
Written 12-month workmanship warranty on every job
RGI registered, fully insured, references on request
